snapshot.title: Show 'Free Operations unlocked' messaging when M4 completes
snapshot.description: Post-M4 spec (2026-03-10) explicitly states: 'Free Operations unlock should be shown explicitly in UI messaging.' When mission stage crosses into Free Ops (post-M4), show clear messaging that free operations are now available with brief explanation of the two routes (contract, survey).

acceptanceCriteria.text: When M4 completes, player sees a clear 'Free Operations unlocked' moment (overlay, banner, or debrief callout)
Messaging explains the two routes: contract (work for a contractor) and survey (scan and discover)
Shown only once; persisted so it does not re-trigger on subsequent sessions
